meta.title: Day 1: Alex's My First Standup
meta.title_zh: 第 1 天：Alex 的入门故事

study_card.difficulty: 入门故事 · 词汇主线
study_card.main_practice: 先听故事 · 再跟读 · 最后替换成自己的经历
value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
电脑硬件与设备 × 问候和自我介绍 × 仓库与 README
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 听读 2 遍 · 遮住中文复述 · 完成输出任务

segments.en: My name is Alex. Today is Monday, my first day at a new job. I am a new engineer. My team makes a chat program. In the morning, Maria shows me the "hardware" and "device". I look carefully and repeat the words. She smiles and says "Nice to meet you." and "How are you doing?". After lunch, she shows me the "repository" and "README file" on GitHub. I am a little nervous, but Maria smiles and says that I can take my time.
segments.tts: My name is Alex. Today is Monday, my first day at a new job. I am a new engineer. My team makes a chat program. In the morning, Maria shows me the "hardware" and "device". I look carefully and repeat the words. She smiles and says "Nice to meet you." and "How are you doing?". After lunch, she shows me the "repository" and "README file" on GitHub. I am a little nervous, but Maria smiles and says that I can take my time.
segments.zh: 我叫 Alex。今天是周一，是我新工作的第一天。我是一名新工程师。我的团队在制作一个聊天程序。早上，Maria 给我看了硬件、设备。我仔细观察并重复这些词。她微笑着说“很高兴认识你、你最近怎么样”。午饭后，她在 GitHub 上给我看了仓库、README 文件。我有点紧张，但 Maria 说我可以慢慢来。

hard.def: 硬件，电脑中可以实际触摸到的部件
设备，用来完成某项工作的电子工具
仓库，集中存放项目代码和历史记录的地方
README 文件，介绍项目用途和使用方法的说明文件

segments.en: After the morning meeting, Maria helps me learn the project. She points to the "monitor" and "keyboard" and shows me where the files are. Then she says "My name is ..." and "I'm new here.". I answer slowly and try to sound friendly. Together, we read the "source code" and "project folder" and find the next small task. I do not know every word yet, but I feel better because the team is kind.
segments.tts: After the morning meeting, Maria helps me learn the project. She points to the "monitor" and "keyboard" and shows me where the files are. Then she says "My name is ..." and "I'm new here.". I answer slowly and try to sound friendly. Together, we read the "source code" and "project folder" and find the next small task. I do not know every word yet, but I feel better because the team is kind.
segments.zh: 早上会议结束后，Maria 帮我了解项目。她指着显示器、键盘，并告诉我文件在哪里。然后她说：“我的名字是……、我是新来的。”我慢慢回答，并努力让自己的语气听起来友好。我们一起阅读源代码、项目文件夹，找到下一个小任务。我还不认识所有单词，但团队很友善，所以我感觉好多了。

hard.def: 显示器，用来显示电脑画面
键盘，用来输入文字和命令
源代码，程序员编写的程序文本
项目文件夹，保存一个项目相关文件的目录

segments.en: Before I leave, Maria gives me a small task. I use the "mouse" and "power button" to finish it and then save my work. She asks me about "Where are you from?" and "See you later.". I listen, smile, and say goodbye. Then I open GitHub and look at the "code hosting" and "public repository" with her. It is my first day, and I am ready to learn one small step at a time.
segments.tts: Before I leave, Maria gives me a small task. I use the "mouse" and "power button" to finish it and then save my work. She asks me about "Where are you from?" and "See you later.". I listen, smile, and say goodbye. Then I open GitHub and look at the "code hosting" and "public repository" with her. It is my first day, and I am ready to learn one small step at a time.
segments.zh: 离开前，Maria 给我一个小任务。我用鼠标、电源按钮完成任务并保存工作。她问我你来自哪里、回头见，我认真听、微笑，然后道别。接着我打开 GitHub，和她一起查看代码托管、公开仓库。这是我的第一天，我准备一步一步学习。

hard.def: 鼠标，用来移动光标和点击
电源按钮，用来开机或关机
代码托管，把代码保存在可协作的网络平台上
公开仓库，任何人都能查看的仓库
